D.treatment: AdaBoost using fused E3Sense EEG, eye-tracking, and EDA features

O.outcome_detail: balanced one-off accuracy for five-level segment engagement prediction

cells.quote: E3Sense achieves 75.0% balanced one-off accuracy, which gives equal weight to each engagement class and counts predictions within one level of the learner’s rating as correct. This exceeds the sensor-free baseline of 63.0% by 12.0 percentage points (Section 7.1).
cells.note: The study describes these comparisons as descriptive and reports no significance test.

D.treatment: exploratory calibration model conditioned on learners’ engagement-definition codes
D.comparison: matched calibration model without definition context

O.outcome_detail: balanced one-off accuracy for five-level segment engagement prediction

cells.quote: In the complementary analysis, learners described engagement through cognitive, behavioral, and emotional criteria. Incorporating these criteria into an exploratory calibration model increased balanced one-off accuracy from 64.6% to 71.5% relative to a matched model without this context, an observed +6.9-percentage-point difference alongside lower macro-MAE.
cells.note: This is an exploratory analysis of 18 participants and uses a separate evaluation protocol; no significance test is reported.
